sentences.text: Sterling Malory Archer , known simply as Archer , is the titular character and the main protagonist of the American animated comedy series Archer .	Archer	Archer (TV series)	titular character	titular character	animated	animated	comedy series	comedy series

For the first four seasons , he is a special agent of the intelligence agency ISIS -LRB- International Secret Intelligence Service -RRB- , working at the agency 's main headquarters in New York City .	New York City	New York City
After ISIS is shut down by the FBI , Archer takes on new roles as a drug dealer , CIA contractor , and private investigator in seasons five , six , and seven respectively .	Archer	Archer (TV series)

Archer was created by Adam Reed , who began working on the character shortly after the conclusion of the television series Frisky Dingo .	Archer	Archer (TV series)	Adam Reed	Adam Reed	Frisky Dingo	Frisky Dingo
The character is voiced by actor H. Jon Benjamin .	H. Jon Benjamin	H. Jon Benjamin

Largely influenced by Ian Fleming 's vision of James Bond , Archer has been described as pompous , misogynist , egotistical , and attractive .	Archer	Archer (TV series)	Ian Fleming	Ian Fleming	James Bond	James Bond	pompous	pompous	misogynist	misogynist	egotistical	egotistical	attractive	Physical attractiveness
The character is highly promiscuous , often verging on hypersexual proportions , and is a heavy alcoholic .	hypersexual	hypersexual	alcoholic	alcoholic

His habitual use of alcohol can be seen as a parallel to Bond , who was an ardent drinker and smoker throughout much of the James Bond novels .	James Bond	James Bond	James Bond novels	List of James Bond novels and stories

A portion of the show 's plot has been devoted to Archer searching for his biological father , which has resulted in growing tensions between him and his mother Malory Archer .	Archer	Archer (TV series)
Throughout the series ' run , the character has received positive reviews from critics .
Among their points of praise is Benjamin 's voicework , citing his delivery and distinctive monotone voice as highlights of the show .

For his portrayal , he has been nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Voice-Over Performance and an Annie Award for Voice Acting in a Television Production .
